notes: FIX: the 'app resets every so often' problem. The SW update check runs every 15 min and USED to silently reload you within 500ms of detecting a new version — so every time I shipped (4 ships in the last hour), anyone with BM open got auto-reloaded. Now replaced with a non-intrusive bottom toast '🎉 New Branch Manager version ready · Refresh now · Later'. If a form is open, the prompt defers 2 min and retries. Tapping Later postpones 30 min. You stay in control of when to reload. Cold-load self-healing (on stale bundle detection) is unchanged — that one IS a reload, but only runs once per stale bundle.
